limits: Administrator authentication still depends on PostgreSQL and can fail before bounded readiness probes.
Readiness does not measure media playback, writable attachment fsync, proxy TLS, telemetry export or full journal continuity.
Literal source anchors detect the documented explicit settings and added selected timeout/retry/TURN configuration; they do not measure SDK/OS/Caddy defaults or production config drift.
New incident/media dashboards are source handoff; production import and access/installed-version verification remain separate.
Application administrator does not gain infrastructure credentials or direct-message reading access.
